title: Verificación: AMD RX 7800 XT ROCm llama.cpp benchmark (Qwen 27B Q3: 549 pp / 23.4 tg t/s) - mostly confirmed, more testing planned
summary: Claim revisado: Strong prefill and decent generation on older/smaller AMD cards with ROCm 7.2.3 + HIP llama.cpp. Evidencia: Original post with full stack (Ubuntu 24.04.4, Kernel 6.17, ROCm 7.2.3, gfx1101, exact pp512/tg128 numbers, Q3_K_M). Replies positive ('impressive', 'solid for the price'). Author commits to 'ROCm vs Vulkan comparisons' and real tasks.. Caveat editorial: Numbers are early; full validation and direct Vulkan comparison still pending from the same tester.. Reproducibilidad: high - complete reproducible stack, model, quant, exact benchmark commands implied (pp/tg), photo of results.
